scope: Bounded isolated actual-NoAr protocol tests; no broadcast readiness or deployment approval
coverage: Seven selected input/output pairings, not all 28 combinations

rust.all_features_caveat: ORT_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1; optional ONNX native runtime is not linked or exercised

limitations: Synthetic loopback streams and disposable API/database data only
Normal SRT uses MediaMTX; SCTE-35 SRT uses a direct native listener because MediaMTX strips cues
HLS transport and manifest cues are independently decoded; downstream ad insertion is not tested
A four-second publisher interruption can be partly absorbed by upstream buffering
No long soak, multicast, GPU or browser signal-test validation in this matrix
Recording presence is checked; recording decode and retention are separate
Complete Docker image build is NOT_AVAILABLE due to executor disk limits
Optional ONNX runtime download is NOT_AVAILABLE due to proxy policy
